title: Bashar :: Knocking on Heaven's Door- Highlights
author: Bashar Channeled by Darryl Anka
opening_summary: Bashar introduces a transmission titled 'Knocking on Heaven's Door,' explaining that the veil between physical and non-physical realities is thinning with increased blending of material and spiritual dimensions. He describes an impressive spherical spaceship or space station capable of shifting between different dimensions, functioning as a multidimensional hub or way station. The craft operates similarly to a bus stop, allowing beings from various dimensions to board and disembark as it traverses different dimensional frequencies, facilitating interdimensional travel and exchange.

blending going on between material and spiritual realities
